class.name: MaszynaE3DRenderingServer
class.brief_description: RID based server of E3D model instances.
class.description: The [ModelRenderingServer] backend [code]maszyna[/code], with an API similar to [RenderingServer]. An instance is created with [method instance_create], set up with the [code]instance_set_*[/code] methods and [method instance_attach_object_instance_id], and built with [method instance_build]. The [enum ModelRenderingServer.Instancer] of an instance selects how it is built: [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] renders every submodel as a [RenderingServer] instance without creating any nodes (used for scenery models), [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_NODES] and [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_EDITABLE_NODES] build a [Node3D]/[MeshInstance3D]/[SpotLight3D] tree under the attached node. [code]MaszynaE3DModelInstance[/code] is a node client of this server. [RenderingServer] instances are freed when the singleton is deleted. Scenery placements are registered with [method instance_register] instead: [SceneryStreamingServer] builds them only while its camera is within their visibility range of the chunk they fall into, and clears them again when it leaves.

method.name: emission_light_create
method.description: An addressable light [param light_name] of [param instance] that only switches the model's own [code]light_onNN[/code]/[code]light_offNN[/code] submodels.

method.name: environment_set_light_level
method.description: How bright the scene is, 0-1 - what the [constant LIGHT_MODE_DARK] and [constant LIGHT_MODE_HOME] lights follow. Pushed by [code]EnvironmentNode[/code].

method.name: environment_set_time
method.description: The time of day [param hours] - what the [constant LIGHT_MODE_HOME] lights follow. Pushed by [code]EnvironmentNode[/code].

method.name: instance_get_attached_node
method.description: The instance id of the node attached with [method instance_attach_object_instance_id] - the one a node tree is built under - or [code]0[/code] for none, or for one that is gone.

method.name: instance_get_data_path
method.description: The directory the instance's model and textures are read from.

method.name: instance_get_light_count
method.description: How many lights of [param instance] are addressed by index ([code]light_on00[/code]...), 0 until the instance is built.

method.name: instance_get_model
method.description: The model the instance draws.

method.name: instance_get_model_filename
method.description: The model file of a registered instance ([method instance_register]); empty for one created from a model ([method instance_create]).

method.name: instance_get_opaque_meshes
method.description: The instance ids of the [MeshInstance3D] nodes of the instance's opaque submodels - what the original draws into its pick buffer; a translucent submodel is left out. Empty for an instance not built as nodes.

method.name: instance_get_skins
method.description: The skins the instance's model is drawn with.

method.name: instance_set_layer_mask
method.description: Render layers of an [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance.

method.name: instance_set_light_blink
method.description: The light [param light] of [param instance] blinks: [param on_time] seconds lit, [param off_time] dark, starting [param phase] into the cycle.

method.name: instance_set_light_mode
method.description: The light [param light] of [param instance] in [param mode], blinking at the default times.

method.name: instance_set_lights_colors
method.description: The colours of the lights of [param instance], by name ([method light_get_name] of a scenery node's light): a scenery node's [code]lightcolors[/code].

method.name: instance_set_lights_modes
method.description: The scenery node's [code]lights[/code] list of [param instance], by light index (light 0 is [code]"00"[/code], [code]AnimModel.cpp:303[/code]); a fraction of a mode is its own darkness threshold.

method.name: instance_set_smoke_intensity
method.description: Spawn rate multiplier of every particle emitter of the instance, as the engine state drives it. [code]1.0[/code] is the emitter template's own rate - what a scenery chimney keeps. An [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCE_KIND_DYNAMIC] instance starts at [code]0.0[/code] and spawns nothing until its client sets the rate. Only the rate: nothing here may reach a particle that is already in the air. Both the process material's colour and its initial colour ramp are read on every frame, so driving either of them from the engine state steps the whole plume down together instead of letting it thin out.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_done_event
method.description: Queues the [ScenarioEventServer] [param event] whenever [param submodel] of [param instance] finishes an animation - the scenery's [code]<model>.<submodel>:done[/code] (TAnimContainer::EventAssign(), Event.cpp:1588-1592). Forgotten when the event or the instance is freed.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_rotation
method.description: Turns [param submodel] of [param instance] towards [param degrees] about its own x, y and z at [param speed] degrees per second (a scenery [code]animation ... rotate[/code] event, [code]TAnimContainer::SetRotateAnim()[/code]); [signal instance_submodel_animation_finished] when it gets there.

method.name: instance_set_submodel_translation
method.description: Moves [param submodel] of [param instance] towards [param offset] at [param speed] metres per second ([code]animation ... translate[/code], [code]TAnimContainer::SetTranslateAnim()[/code]); [signal instance_submodel_animation_finished] when it gets there.

method.name: instance_set_visibility_range
method.description: Limits the visibility range of all submodels of an [constant ModelRenderingServer.INSTANCER_OPTIMIZED] instance, [code]0[/code] - no limit. Rebuilds an already built instance.

method.name: light_disable
method.description: Puts [param light] out, whatever its mode says.

method.name: light_enable
method.description: Lights [param light], whatever its mode says.

method.name: light_free
method.description: Frees [param light].

method.name: light_get_name
method.description: The name of the scenery node's light [param index]: its [code]light_onNN[/code] submodel's, [code]"00"[/code] for light 0.

method.name: light_get_statistics
method.description: [code]total[/code], [code]lit[/code], [code]spot[/code], [code]omni[/code] and [code]synthesized[/code] counts of the lights, for the scenery streaming debug panel.

method.name: material_set_preloader
method.description: Sets [code]material_preloader(model: MaszynaE3DModel, data_path: String, skins: PackedStringArray, max_texture_size: int) -> Variant[/code], called on the streaming's and the vehicles' preload workers ([code]MaszynaMaterialManager.preload_model_materials[/code]).

method.name: material_set_resolver
method.description: Called as [code]material_resolver(submodel: MaszynaE3DSubModel, data_path: String, skins: PackedStringArray, translucency: Translucency, max_texture_size: int) -> Material[/code] for every rendered submodel. Set by [code]MaszynaMaterialManager[/code].

method.name: model_set_loader
method.description: Called as [code]model_loader(data_path: String, filename: String) -> MaszynaE3DModel[/code] - a model's name split into its directory and its file - by [method ModelRenderingBackend.model_load], and on the streaming worker thread for instances registered with [method instance_register] that enter the camera's range. The result is memoized per path. Set by [code]MaszynaE3DModelManager[/code].

method.name: omni_light_create
method.description: An addressable light [param light_name] of [param instance] that also owns an omni [RenderingServer] light, made of the submodel at [param submodel_path].

method.name: smoke_rebuild
method.description: Makes every instance's particle emitters again, resolved anew - what the source resolver makes them of or draws them with has changed (the sprite of [code]maszyna/smoke/generator_mode[/code]). The emitters are [SmokeServer]'s; it builds them again itself when one of its settings changes.

method.name: smoke_set_source_resolver
method.description: Called as [code]smoke_source_resolver(template_name: String) -> Dictionary[/code] when an instance's emitters are made: [code]source[/code] is the [SmokeSource] the [SmokeServer] emitter is made of (null leaves it unbuilt), [code]sprite[/code] the [Texture2D] a particle is drawn with, null for the core's own smoke. Set by [code]MaszynaSmokeSourceLibrary[/code], which reads the templates from the game's [code]data/[/code] directory.

method.name: spot_light_create
method.description: An addressable light [param light_name] of [param instance] that also owns a spot [RenderingServer] light, made of the submodel at [param submodel_path].

signal.name: instance_submodel_animation_finished
signal.description: [param submodel] of [param instance] reached what [method instance_set_submodel_rotation] or [method instance_set_submodel_translation] sent it to ([code]TAnimContainer[/code]'s [code]evDone[/code], [code]AnimModel.cpp:112-120, 175-180[/code]).

constants.constant: The submodel is drawn as its material says: opaque, or cut out at the alpha threshold.
Alpha-blended - a forced submodel drawn as nodes.
Opaque whatever its texture's alpha - a forced submodel of the optimized instancer, which never draws in the alpha pass.
The light comes on by itself once it gets dark.
Like [constant LIGHT_MODE_DARK], but out late at night ([code]AnimModel.cpp:601-607[/code]).
